headline: BULLISH
headline_tag: Uptrend intact, short-term mood flat ahead of the Fed

action.title: SCALE UP acquisition budget
action.detail: The model's call is to scale up the acquisition budget: the longer-term trend and the last three months both lean up, with high confidence (71/100 after today's news, 84 on market data alone), so this is a reasonable time to fund growth, weighted toward channels that bring active traders rather than stablecoin-only users. Because the short-term mood is flat, price is only about 3% above its 50-day average and the Fed meets on 27–28 October, grow the budget in steps and keep part of it flexible to pause if price closes below $81,858 (the 50-day average). This is a budget posture based on trailing data, not a price call or trading advice.

reasons: Price is about 16% above its 200-day average and up 31% over 90 days.
About 72% of the last 90 days closed above the long-term average.
Price ($84,135) sits between the $81,858 50-day average and the $86,480 30-day high.
The US OCC finalized the first stablecoin rulebook under the GENIUS Act, a long-term positive.
watch: The bigger picture leans up, but the short-term mood has gone flat and price swings are near their calmest of the year ahead of the 27–28 October Fed meeting; quiet stretches like this have often ended with a bigger move in either direction. A close below $81,858 would test the uptrend; a close above $86,480 would ease the worry.
analysis: Bottom line: the bigger trend still leans up and today's news adds a little to it, but the short term has gone flat. Short term, the mood is neutral: the Fear & Greed reading is a warm 68 out of 100, yet fewer people than usual are paying extra to bet on a rise, and price swings are near their calmest of the year (PANews, citing K33). If price closes above $86,480 (the 30-day high) the short-term picture turns clearly up; below $81,858 (the 50-day average) it turns down, and in between expect choppy days. Steady messaging fits this week; a clean break out of that range is what would call for a change of pace.

Over the next month, the picture leans moderately up. Price is about 31% higher than three months ago and about 72% of the last 90 days finished above the long-term average, though the past week added only about 2%. There is room to climb if price gets above $86,603 (the 90-day high); the move fades if price slips below $81,858 (the 50-day average), about 3% under today's $84,135. The Fed's 27–28 October meeting is the next scheduled event, and holding above the 50-day line through it would keep growth campaigns well timed.

Over three to six months, the trend leans up with the most confidence of the three. Price is about 16% above its 200-day average, but that average is rising only slowly and price is still about a third below its record, so this is an early recovery rather than a mature uptrend. News is adding a little here: the US bank regulator (OCC) finalized the first rulebook for stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act, and Standard Chartered agreed to buy crypto custodian Zodia Custody (both PANews). The recovery stays intact while price holds above $72,814 (the 200-day average), with $66,774 (the 200-week average) as the next floor and $124,753 (the all-time high) as the far marker; a faster-rising 200-day average would strengthen this read and supports steady investment in new-user acquisition.

team_notes.marketing: Lean into growth with a steady, confident tone: the bigger trend is up and this week's news is about rules and banks embracing crypto, but no rally is under way, so favour trust, access and education stories and keep rally creatives ready in case the range breaks.

items.theme: On-chain futures exchanges seek US licences
items.why: Lighter, an on-chain exchange for futures-style contracts, said it plans to apply to the US CFTC for a derivatives licence in November and already has over 1 million accounts. Its LIT token rose sharply on the news, and separately Kalshi said users will be able to borrow against BTC and ETH to trade similar contracts.
items.marketing_angle: A plain explainer on how regulated and on-chain trading venues differ suits active-trader audiences.

sources.title: Lighter plans to apply for derivatives license with CFTC in November, LIT surges over 22%
Kalshi to allow users to borrow against crypto assets like BTC and ETH to trade perpetual contracts
